evaluation.source: The saved pre-release pipeline, evaluated once on the untouched 20% test split after model selection was frozen.
evaluation.cv_protocol: screening: RepeatedStratifiedKFold(5 x 3, seed 42) on the training set; tuning: RandomizedSearchCV(12 draws, StratifiedKFold(5, seed 42), macro F1); finalists: RepeatedStratifiedKFold(5 x 3, seed 44) — fresh folds, identical for every finalist
evaluation.selection_rule:
best = highest mean macro F1 on the stage-3 folds.  A finalist is "not distinguishable from best" if the Nadeau-Bengio
           corrected paired t-statistic of (best - finalist) is below 2.0.  Among the indistinguishable set choose the SIMPLEST model
           (fixed complexity ranking below); ties -> lower fold-to-fold std of macro F1 (more stable); then higher balanced accuracy.
           The test set, the temporal evaluation and the regression experiment play NO part in selection.

tuning.method: Default settings; not among the five algorithms tuned.

five_fold_train.protocol: Best configuration of each algorithm in the screening stage (RepeatedStratifiedKFold(5 x 3, seed 42) on the training set)

repeated.protocol: Finalists on identical fresh folds (RepeatedStratifiedKFold(5 x 3, seed 44) — fresh folds, identical for every finalist)

fold_audit.conclusion: Each validation fold holds only a handful of Flops, so fold-level and test-level Flop metrics cannot be reliable; they are reported but not trusted.

skipped.reason: A regressor, not a classifier. Evaluated only as a separate experiment (regression on the IMDb score, converted to classes) and not eligible for selection.

regression_experiment.definition: Predict the continuous IMDb score from the same 9 inputs, then convert with the target's own bins (below 3 = Flop, 3 to below 6 = Average, 6 and above = Hit). Same CV folds as stage 1. A separate experiment: not eligible for selection.

temporal.note: Preprocessing and models are refit on the earlier period only. Films with a missing year are excluded. Reporting only: not used for selection.

temporal_validation.note: Preprocessing and models are refit on the earlier period only. Films with a missing year are excluded. Reporting only: not used for selection.

feature_set.rule: adopt experience counts only if paired CV macro-F1 gain > 0.01 and balanced accuracy does not fall
